hub.title: Central Energy & Schedule System
hub.description: Configure global sensors for energy arbitrage and scheduling.

data.cycle_entity: Sensor or helper for week cycle (optional)
data.notify_sensor_offline: Send notification if a window sensor goes offline or unavailable
data.notify_persistent: Show notification in Home Assistant notifications panel
data.notify_service: Mobile notification service (e.g. notify.notify or notify.mobile_app_phone)
data.presence_entities: Presence entities for Auto-Away (e.g. person.* or zone.home)
data.auto_away_delay_minutes: Auto-Away delay when nobody is home (minutes)
data.solar_buffer_enabled: Enable solar surplus & negative price thermal buffer
data.solar_buffer_offset: Extra temperature buffer during free energy (+°C)

data.ac_temp_offset: AC ceiling stratification offset when heating (+°C)
data.valve_exercise_enabled: Enable weekly anti-calcification TRV valve exercise
